name: Ningen ni Narenai
source:
A (self-proclaimed) heartwarming visual novel about spending the days with your dog.
Mugi-chan was abandoned at the shrine; now it's time to take him home!

But beware: your guys' mental health is already in shambles! 
Let your guard down, and you break!
Every day, you have 6 options! Talk, eat, bathe, clean, shop, sleep...
Live the days like a human! This world might be a dump, but let's make it out alive!

[From [url=https://meikatsudon.itch.io/i-cant-be-human]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一本（自称的）温馨的视觉小说，讲述与你的狗共度时光的故事。
麦酱被遗弃在神社；现在是时候带他回家了！

但要小心：你们这些家伙的心理健康已经一团糟了！
放松警惕，你就会崩溃！
每天，你有6个选择！说话、吃饭、洗澡、打扫卫生、购物、睡觉……
像人一样过日子！这个世界可能是垃圾场，但我们要活着出去！

[来自[url=https://meikatsudon.itch.io/i-cant-be-human]Itch.io[/url]]
